沿箭头阅读：输入 → 特征处理 → 输出。滚轮缩放，拖动画布平移，拖动节点调整位: Follow the arrows: input → processing → output. Wheel zooms, drag the canvas to pan, drag nodes to rearrange, double-click empty space to fit; select a module for details and source comments. Shapes omit the batch axis.
选择左侧模块，查看它的作用和形状变化。: Select a module to see its purpose and shape changes.
下图是参数值，不是模型运行时的激活或注意力概率；不能据此判断训练效果。: These are parameters, not runtime activations or attention probabilities. They do not establish model quality.
指向图中的单元格，查看坐标和参数值。: Point at a cell to inspect its coordinates and value.
完整权重文件（用于精确切片）: Full weights for exact large-tensor slices
此节点没有可查看的参数张量。: This node has no parameter tensors to inspect.
没有内嵌参数数据，仍可查看全部节点与连接。: No embedded parameter data. All nodes and connections remain available.
每格是对应坐标范围的均值。: Each cell is the mean of its coordinate range.
每格是一个原始 float32 参数。: Each cell is one original float32 parameter.
整个张量的分块均值：轴 0 × 其余轴展平。加载权重可查看精确值和任意切片。: Whole-tensor tile means: axis 0 × flattened remaining axes. Load weights for exact values and arbitrary slices.
把符号编号转换为特征向量，再加入位置信息。: Convert token IDs into feature vectors and add position information.
先用因果自注意力汇聚前面的信息，再用前馈网络处理各位置；两部分都有归一化和残差连: Causal self-attention gathers preceding context, then a feed-forward network processes each position. Both stages use normalization and residual connections.
先用双向自注意力交换位置信息，再用前馈网络处理各位置；两部分都有残差连接。: Bidirectional self-attention exchanges information between positions, followed by a feed-forward network. Both stages use residual connections.
逐步读取序列，用重置门和更新门控制记忆。所有时间步共享权重，输出包含每一步的隐藏: Read the sequence step by step, controlling memory with reset and update gates. All steps share weights; the output contains every hidden state.
先提取局部图案，再用 ReLU 保留正响应。: Extract local patterns, then retain positive responses with ReLU.
先对各通道的空间位置取平均，再映射为分类得分。: Average spatial positions in each channel, then project to class scores.
把最后一维映射为各类别的原始得分；这里没有 Softmax。: Map the last dimension to raw class scores. No Softmax is applied here.
对最后一维做线性映射；其他轴保持不变。: Apply a linear map to the last dimension, leaving other axes unchanged.
用共享卷积核提取图片中的局部特征。: Extract local image features using shared convolution kernels.
让序列位置之间交换信息；是否允许看后面的位置由 causal 决定。: Exchange information between sequence positions; causal controls access to later positions.
输入绕过内部计算，与内部结果相加。: Add the input directly to the result of the inner computation.
沿时间轴逐步执行，传递隐藏状态，各步共享同一套权重。: Scan along time, passing hidden state between steps with shared weights.
重复执行内部模块，各轮共享同一套权重。: Repeat the inner module using the same weights each time.
保存上一时间步的隐藏状态，初始值为零。: Hold the previous step's hidden state, initialized to zero.
对每个通道的空间位置取平均，保留通道维度。: Average spatial positions per channel, preserving the channel axis.
取序列最后一个时间步的特征。: Take features from the final sequence step.
按门值 g 混合两个输入：g × a + (1 − g) × b。: Mix two inputs using gate g: g × a + (1 − g) × b.
按连接顺序执行内部层；展开内部层可查看具体计算。: Execute the inner layers in connection order. Expand layers to inspect the computation.
模型接收的数据。形状不包含批次维度。: Data received by the model. The shape omits the batch axis.
模型返回的结果。分类得分不一定是概率。: The model's result. Classification scores are not necessarily probabilities.
按图中的连线处理输入。: Process inputs along the displayed connections.
节点 ID 必须是唯一字符串: Node IDs must be unique strings
张量过大，无法精确索引: Tensor too large for exact indexing
权重文件 SHA-256 与模型不符: Weights file SHA-256 does not match this model
请加载匹配的权重以查看这些值: Load matching weights to inspect these values
格子表示元素位置，不是运行值；省略号表示只展示部分元素。: Cells show element positions, not runtime values; … indicates omitted elements.
此图没有附带源码注释。: This graph has no attached source comments.
按选择器只执行其中一个分支；所有分支保持相同的形状和类型。: A selector runs exactly one branch; every branch preserves shape and dtype.
被选中分支的结果从这里继续向后传递。: The selected branch result continues from here.
重复执行内部模块，各轮共享权重；停止概率决定各步结果的加权。: Repeat the inner module with shared weights; halting probabilities weight each step result.
沿时间轴逐步执行，显式传递状态字段，各步共享同一套权重。: Scan along time, passing explicit state fields with weights shared across steps.
把外部张量或上一步状态送入内部模块。: Feed an outer tensor or previous state into the inner module.
模块额外导出的命名结果。: A named result exported by the module.
